scheduler.title: Scheduling
scheduler.subtitle: Daily limits, retention, learning steps and day boundary (default deck)
scheduler.invalidLearnAhead: Learn ahead must be an integer between 0 and 60 minutes
scheduler.retentionHint: Target chance of recalling a card when it comes due (0.5–0.99, 0.9 = 90% recommended); higher values strengthen recall at the cost of more daily reviews.
scheduler.invalidLimit: Daily limits must be integers between 0 and {{max}}
scheduler.invalidRetention: Desired retention must be between {{min}} and {{max}}
scheduler.enableFuzz: Spread out due dates (fuzz intervals so cards learned together don't pile up)
scheduler.stepsHint: Separate steps with spaces using s / m / h / d units, e.g. "1m 10m"; leave empty to let FSRS choose short-term intervals.
scheduler.rolloverHint: Reviews before this hour still count toward the previous day, which suits late-night study (Anki defaults to 4).
scheduler.longStepWarning: FSRS works best when every step finishes the same day (under 1 day); long steps can make Hard longer than Good.
scheduler.invalidSteps: Invalid steps: use positive numbers with s / m / h / d units, at most 16 steps of up to 365 days each
scheduler.invalidRollover: The day boundary must be an integer between 0 and 23
scheduler.invalidMaximumInterval: Maximum interval must be an integer between 1 and {{max}} days
scheduler.invalidMaxAnswerSeconds: Maximum answer time must be an integer between 1 and 3600 seconds
scheduler.orderHint: With a large backlog, "most likely forgotten first" loses fewer cards; buried siblings (reverse cards, other cloze deletions of the same note) never appear back to back.

optimizer.title: Personalized Memory Pacing (FSRS Optimizer)
optimizer.usingDefaults: Using FSRS-6 general default parameters (tuned to average human memory curves).

optimizer.personalizedSince: Using your personalized memory parameters (tuned on {{date}} from {{count}} reviews).
optimizer.optimized: Parameters updated to fit your memory: prediction error (log loss) {{before}} → {{after}} (lower means more accurate scheduling), trained on {{reviews}} reviews; {{cards}} cards were rescheduled.
optimizer.alreadyOptimal: Your current parameters already fit your memory well (prediction error / log loss {{logLoss}}); nothing changed.
optimizer.notEnoughData: Not enough review history to train yet ({{items}} samples). Keep reviewing — personalization improves noticeably after a few hundred reviews.
optimizer.hint: Optimization runs locally on your device and never uploads data; once a month is plenty.

insights.title: Retention and memory
insights.hintV7: Counts only each card's first formal review per study day (anything except Again counts as recalled). Mature cards had a scheduled interval ≥ 21 days. Trial uses default FSRS-7 parameters.
insights.hint: True retention counts only each card's first review per day (anything except Again counts as recalled). Mature cards have memory stability ≥ 21 days. If retention stays below target, optimize personalized parameters in Scheduling below.
